claims: Pop music is short for "popular music".
Pop music emerged in the mid-1950s in the US and UK.
Pop music originated as a youth-oriented, rhythm-driven alternative to rock and roll.
Pop music evolved through various subgenres like synth-pop and K-pop.
Pop music evolved from rock and roll to cater to teenage audiences.
Pop music began with 1950s/60s rock influences.
Pop music evolved into modern, globalized forms including K-pop.
Pop subgenres include synth-pop, electropop, indie-pop, bubblegum pop, and K-pop.
Pop is a common term for carbonated drinks.
Pop is a sharp, explosive noise.
Funko POP! figures are stylized collectibles.
POP is used for point-of-purchase displays in retail.
A 36s YouTube video by English with Ronnie from EnglishLessons4U with engVid explains the different meanings of the word 'pop'.
The video was uploaded on Aug 26, 2021.
